question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,
        sr.name AS sales_rep_name,
        sr.id AS sales_rep_id,
        COUNT(o.id) AS rep_order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON r.id = sr.region_id
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON sr.id = wa.sales_rep_id
    JOIN web_orders o ON wa.id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name, sr.id
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        SUM(rep_order_count) AS total_orders,
        SUM(total_sales) AS region_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
max_sales_per_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(total_sales) AS max_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
)
SELECT 
    rt.region_name,
    CAST(rt.total_orders AS BIGINT) AS total_orders,
    ROUND(rt.region_total_sales, 2) AS region_total_sales,
    rs.sales_rep_name,
    ROUND(rs.total_sales, 2) AS top_rep_sales
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN max_sales_per_region m ON rt.region_name = m.region_name
JOIN rep_sales rs ON rt.region_name = rs.region_name AND rs.total_sales = m.max_total_sales
ORDER BY rt.region_name

WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region_name,

        COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales

),

    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(total_sales) AS max_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.sales_rep_name,
    rs.total_sales,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rs.region_name) AS num_tied
FROM rep_sales rs
JOIN max_sales_per_region m ON rs.region_name = m.region_name AND rs.total_sales = m.max_total_sales
ORDER BY rs.region_name, rs.sales_rep_name", "preview_rows": 20}
